releases.description:
## ✨ New

**Playlists.** A note holding several audio files lines them up as its playlist — and so does a folder: open any audio file and every audio file next to it queues up, sorted the way the file explorer sorts them (`№2` before `№10`), starting on the one you actually clicked.

- **The list lives under the player**, collapsible and remembering whether you left it open. Its heading names the source — the note or the folder — and counts the files.
- **Every row carries its history**: the play counter, and a ⚑ when the track has a marker, so a folder of demos tells you at a glance which ones you have been working on.
- **A click switches tracks without breaking the flow** — if something was playing, the new track keeps playing; a click on the current row is play/pause.
- **`⏮ ⏭` in the transport** walk the list and grey out at its ends, with `Alt+B` / `Alt+N` (and the Russian layout `Alt+И` / `Alt+Т`) doing the same from the keyboard.
- **The list outlives the track**: eject with ⏏ and it stays, so the next take is one click away.
- **Opening a note without audio no longer clears it** — the playlist belongs to the track you are working on, not to the page you happen to be reading, so lyrics and notes can be flipped through while the beats stay queued.

**Drag a track into a note.** Pull a playlist row (or the name of the loaded track) into the editor and an embed of that file lands at the cursor — rendered by this plugin as a waveform player. The link is generated by Obsidian itself, so it follows the vault's link format and path settings.

**Two new settings** under a *Playlist* heading:

- **Whole folder as a playlist** (on) — turn it off to load an opened audio file on its own.
- **Play the playlist through** (off) — when a track ends, the next one starts; the last one simply stops, and a track with an A-B zone keeps looping instead of moving on.

## 🐛 Fixes

- The playlist no longer stops at ~15 rows with empty space below it: the list claims the whole height the player leaves and scrolls inside itself only when it genuinely outgrows the panel, with the waveform and transport staying put.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mrrepac/obsidian-songwriter-player/compare/1.2.1...1.3.0

## ⌨️ Changed

**The default hotkeys lost their `Ctrl`.** Transport keys are meant to be hit with one hand while the other one is on the guitar or the mouse, and `Ctrl+Alt+X` is not that. Every default is now a plain `Alt` chord:

| Command | Was | Now |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Play from marker (or from start) | `Ctrl+Alt+X` | `Alt+X` |
| Stop | `Ctrl+Alt+C` | `Alt+C` |
| Set marker at current position | `Ctrl+Alt+A` | `Alt+Z` |
| Play/Pause | `Ctrl+Alt+P` | `Alt+P` |
| Open track's note | `Ctrl+Alt+S` | `Alt+D` |
| Seek back / forward | `Ctrl+Alt+,` / `Ctrl+Alt+.` | `Alt+,` / `Alt+.` |

"Set marker" moved from `A` to `Z` and "open track's note" from `S` to `D` on purpose: `Alt+A` and `Alt+S` are popular editor bindings, while `Z X C` now sit next to each other under the left hand.

Notes:

- **Your own bindings are untouched.** Anything you had rebound in Settings → Hotkeys stays as it is — new defaults only apply to commands you never touched. To pick up the new scheme on a command you had rebound, reset it there.
- **The Russian keyboard layout is still duplicated** for every binding (`Alt+Ч`, `Alt+С`, `Alt+Я`, `Alt+З`, `Alt+В`, `Alt+Б`, `Alt+Ю`).
- **macOS:** Option+letter produces a special character, so plain `Alt` defaults may not fire there — rebind the transport commands to a `Cmd`- or `Ctrl`-based chord in Settings → Hotkeys.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mrrepac/obsidian-songwriter-player/compare/1.2.0...1.2.1

releases.description:
## ✨ New

**Waveform players inside your notes.** The plain embedded audio players (`![[demo.mp3]]`) are now replaced with a compact waveform wired to the very same player as the sidebar — no more bare grey control bar. Click the wave to play from anywhere, drag to select an A-B loop, double-click to drop your work marker — all in place, right in the note.

- **One player, everywhere.** The embed you're playing shows the live playhead and its button mirrors play/pause; the others stay as a static waveform (with their saved marker and loop) until you tap them. Only one track plays at a time, and the marker, loop zone, play counts and volume all stay in sync with the sidebar.
- **Reading view and Live Preview** — both are covered.
- **Light on resources.** A file's waveform is analyzed only once its player scrolls into view, the peak cache is shared with the sidebar (one decode per file), and idle waveforms park their redraw loop — so a note full of demos stays snappy.
- **New toggle "Waveform players in notes"** (Settings → Songwriter Player, on by default). Turn it off to get the plain player back plus the "open externally" button, exactly as before. Fully localized (EN/RU).

## 🐛 Fixes

- The waveform animation loop now suspends itself when nothing is moving, instead of redrawing at 60fps while idle.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mrrepac/obsidian-songwriter-player/compare/1.1.0...1.2.0

releases.description:
## ✨ New

**Mobile floating button.** A round play button now floats over the note on mobile. Tap it to play from your work marker (or the start) without swiping over to the sidebar player — it sits in the top-right corner and keeps the editor focused, so the on-screen keyboard stays up.

- **Two tap modes** (Settings, mobile only):
  - **Always from marker** (default) — every tap (re)starts the track from the marker.
  - **Smart play/pause** — tap plays from the marker while paused, pauses while playing.
- Enable/disable toggle. Fully localized (EN/RU).

## 🐛 Fixes

- **Track-switching race** — rapidly switching tracks could briefly show the wrong track or apply another track's marker. Loads are now guarded by a token, so a superseded load can't touch the player.
- **Waveform decode cache** — a transient decode failure no longer sticks forever; the waveform retries on the next load instead of staying blank.
- **Playhead on a paused seek** — the cursor now moves when you seek while paused (previously only the time readout updated).
- Internal cleanup: removed dead code, merged duplicate pointer branches, tidied imports.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mrrepac/obsidian-songwriter-player/compare/1.0.2...1.1.0
